title: AS2 editor: add inline error checking via script_check
description: ActionsPanel.tsx has a plain textarea + syntax highlighter but no error checking. The script_check MCP tool (or equivalent AS2 compile-check function) exists. Add a debounced (500ms) compile check that runs on each edit and displays syntax errors inline below the editor (red error banner showing line/column + message). Use the AS2 compiler's parse/check function directly (not MCP) for in-process checking without needing the server.
